# Systems

This area groups the digital infrastructure and software systems used within the Danish healthcare sector to manage patient records and validate clinical quality data. It covers the core operational tools that bridge local electronic records with regional management dashboards, enabling the retroactive correction of missing data and ensuring the accuracy of national quality databases like the Akut Kirurgi Databasen.

## Pages

- [[entities/systems/healthcare-information-systems/index|Healthcare Information Systems]] — The core digital infrastructure used by Danish hospitals and regions to manage patient records, cross-reference local data with national registries, and drive continuous quality assurance.
